title: Moneris Data Layout
applicability: Covers the Appendix V Moneris request and response table layouts carried in Segment 135 and Segment 136; routing and segment-presence rules are not inferred from Appendix V alone.

businessRequirements.title: A Moneris-routed transaction shall include the applicable Moneris Data Segment 135/136.
Supplied request tables shall use Appendix V's defined Table IDs, framing, length bounds, and independently-checkable field formats.
Request Table 005 and Table 006 shall carry the authorization amount and sequence number for completion processing.
Request terminal-capability and response encryption-key tables shall use the source-stated structural boundaries.
The Moneris sequence number shall correlate with the corresponding authorization transaction.
The MAC field shall be a fixed 16-character value in the Moneris request (Table 007) and response (Table 005).
Supplied response tables shall use Appendix V's defined Table IDs, framing, length bounds, and independently-checkable field formats.
Conflicting or incomplete Appendix V field descriptions shall remain explicitly review-gated rather than silently reconciled.

requestTables: 001 SPDH Header an48: Device Type 2 A, Transmission Number 2 N, Moneris Terminal ID 8 A, Filler 8 A, Clerk ID 6 A, Local Date/Time 12 A, Message Type 1 A, Message Subtype 1 A, Transaction Code 2 N, Processing Flags 3 N, Base24 Response Code 3 N
004 Moneris Language Indicator Table Length 001; data code set 3/4/5/6; source data-width attribute an13 conflict review-gated
005 Auth Amount for Completion variable, maximum 007; data attribute an3 conflicts with maximum and remains review-gated
006 Sequence Number an10, sequence to be sent to Moneris
007 MAC an16, algorithm supplied by Moneris
008 Application Account Type an1, debit account type for MAC calculation; code set unspecified
009 Terminal Capabilities and Contactless Processing an2; flag meanings required by Moneris, not published here
responseTables: 001 SPDH Header (same 48-character field structure as request)
005 MAC an16, algorithm supplied by Moneris
006 Encryption Key, maximum length 051; 3-character indicator followed by zero to three 16-byte keys in MAC Encryption/Data Encryption/PIN Encryption order when indicator position is Y

testCases.positive: Supplied request tables use known IDs, valid TLV framing, and stated widths
Table 005 does not exceed 7 characters and Table 006 has its stated 10-character representation
negative: authorization amount or sequence correlation mismatch

testCases.positive: Request Table 009, response Table 006, and both MAC widths conform to stated boundaries
Supplied response tables use known IDs, valid TLV framing, and stated widths
negative: key payload not composed of zero to three 16-byte units

testData.reason: Synthetic source-shaped sample covers all nine request table layouts.
Request Table ID 010 is not defined by Appendix V.
A table header without its declared data is malformed.
SPDH Header Transmission Number is specified as two numeric characters.
Language Indicator code 3 is one of the four listed values.
Language Indicator code 7 is not in the listed 3/4/5/6 matrix.
Code 5 maps Terminal and Merchant Receipt to English, PED and Cardholder Receipt to French.
Request Table 005 uses its stated maximum length of 7.
Request Table 005 exceeds its stated maximum length of 7.
Request Table 007 is exactly 16 characters.
Request Table 007 is shorter than the fixed length of 16.
Request Table 008 is exactly one alphanumeric character; allowed account-type values are not specified.
Request Table 009 is exactly two alphanumeric characters; Moneris flag semantics are not asserted.
Request Table 009 violates the fixed Table Length of 002.
Synthetic source-shaped sample covers all six response tables and maximum key payload.
Response Table ID 007 is not defined by Appendix V.
Response Table 006 begins with the three-character indicator prefix and contains no keys.
A single 16-byte key follows the three-character indicator.
Two 16-byte keys follow the three-character indicator.
Response Table 006 is too short to contain its three-character indicator prefix.
Response Table 006 has one character after the three-character indicator, not a complete 16-byte key unit.
The three Y positions indicate MAC Encryption, Data Encryption, and PIN Encryption in that order; this does not assert the unspecified absent-key marker.
Response Table 006 exceeds the maximum length of 51.
Response Table 005 is exactly 16 characters.
Response Table 005 is shorter than the fixed length of 16.
Appendix V alone does not define a routing predicate or required segment-presence rule.
No source-defined comparison links Moneris Table 006 to Segment 100 Element 86.
Table 004 and 005 data attributes conflict with their stated Table Lengths; response key encoding is unspecified.

testDataStatus: Twenty synthetic, source-shaped fixtures exercise bounded Appendix V checks; none is a Moneris-approved production sample.
